displayName: GHADV-3148: Spring AI's support for Anthropic's Skills API used LLM-influenced filenames unsanitized in Path.resolve before writing
description:
Spring AI's support for Anthropic's Skills API used LLM-influenced filenames unsanitized in Path.resolve before writing files to disk

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: spring ai's support for anthropic's skills api use

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_path_traversal_ghadv_3148", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%spring%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%support%') AND "value" > 0
